summary: Diagnosed and fixed failing test suite in the gizmo-registry monorepo. Added a root svelte.config.js with vitePreprocess, installed bits-ui, @lucide/svelte, and @tanstack/svelte-virtual as dev dependencies, removed the SSR noExternal setting in vitest.config.ts, and stubbed DOM dimensions (clientWidth/clientHeight) in vitest.setup.ts so console virtualization could be tested.
decisions: Added a root svelte.config.js using vitePreprocess to match apps/app's Svelte preprocessing for tests.

Installed bits-ui, @lucide/svelte, and @tanstack/svelte-virtual as dev dependencies at the workspace root (rather than relying on nested packages) so the test runner can resolve Svelte component imports.
Removed the `ssr.noExternal: ['@lucide/svelte', 'bits-ui']` block from vitest.config.ts once those packages became dev dependencies.

Stubbed HTMLElement.prototype.clientWidth and clientHeight via Object.defineProperty in vitest.setup.ts (76 for console-row, 800 for scroll-viewport, 0 otherwise) so @tanstack/svelte-virtual can compute viewport virtualization in jsdom.
errors: 8 test suites failed initially due to unresolved imports of '../../src/extensions/extension-host-service', '../../app-settings', 'bits-ui', and unknown '.svelte' file extension errors for bits-ui/bits-ui and @lucide/svelte.

After preprocessing fix, 4 tests in ChangesPanel.test.ts and ConsolePanel.test.ts failed with Svelte lifecycle_outside_component errors because bits-ui used getContext/setContext during component init.

After dependency reorganization, ConsolePanel test 'only mounts a viewport-sized window from a large console tail' failed expecting fewer than 20 console entries but got 256, because jsdom returned 0 for clientWidth/clientHeight so virtualization never triggered.
